prompt: The printed numbers on the figures differ from the references in this report. Check experiment-source.json and the supplied figures, then fix report.html and report-data.json so a reader can tell which figure each public note refers to. Keep every case. Each cases record must contain case_id, manuscript_number, page_index, printed_folio, source_file and public_note. Retain data-case-id on HTML figures; their visible captions must include qualified Manuscript and Folio numbers, the source filename and the original public note. Keep source evidence and images unchanged. Explain the numbering basis without rewriting the recorded public notes. Do not access the network, run a new experiment or perform Git operations.
expected_behavior: Distinguish document order, internal index, printed folio and source filename; bind each figure and immutable note to the same evidence.
failure_conditions: Document order presented as the printed folio
Image or note associated with another case
Recorded note rewritten to use a different number
Visible caption lacks a qualified identity or source filename

evaluation.scope: Deterministic identity and public-note consistency on synthetic offline figures; not a language-quality evaluation.

rubric.criterion: Document order, index, folio, filename and note agree with source evidence.
All cases and evidence preserved; no additional observations or experiments.
Visible captions and machine-readable results expose the same qualified identity.
